rows.grounds: relative pronoun yad plus bhavet (may be)
fused sandhi tasya antaḥ, not split

items.question: Is the end of even very great merit counted?
premises: Very great merit has no counted end.
items.inference: Even immense merit is reckoned as without end.
uncertainties: sandhi fusion tasyānto is analyzed as fused, not split
case of puṇyaṃ is ambiguous between nominative and accusative
items.plain_english: Whatever very great merit there may be, its end is not counted.
